payload.rationale: The document directly extends Narrative_AutomatedSlugResolution (how the ingestion pipeline derives identifiers when an explicit id is omitted) and bears on the unplaced Position_ImplicitIdSlugResolution (how the submission pipeline should resolve identity and persist files without an explicit id). The two prior expressions from Sample_1SampleMemoryWithDistinctiveHeading establish the existing claims this Phase 2 document reproduces and extends: that a memory was submitted without an id field, and that the pipeline must produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback. Actor_XenaExpertgh is the sole participant and voice behind those expressions. I deliberately did not expand ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst — it concerns consulting methodology (diagnostic-first engagement) and has no bearing on the pipeline's id-derivation or slug-generation behavior this document tests.
